subject: Quick reschedule? Today's demo didn't connect
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@brightgrid.co>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-11-08 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Apologies — missed our demo today

Hi Soojin,

Sorry about that — I hopped into the link for our scheduled call and it looks like we were out of sync on timing (my fault, messed up the timezone conversion). Really interested in seeing Redwood in action — BrightGrid is evaluating inference platforms for a recommender proof-of-concept. Can we find another short window this week? Prefer mornings PT for the team (10–11am PT is best).

Also looping in my product lead, Maya (cc'd). If there's an async 10-minute overview I can watch before a live slot, that'd be great.

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Product, BrightGrid
oliver@brightgrid.co

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@brightgrid.co>
Cc: Maya Lee <maya@brightgrid.co>
Date: 2029-11-08 18:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Apologies — missed our demo today

Hi Oliver — no worries at all, thanks for the note.

We can absolutely rebook a quick walk-through this week. Two options that tend to work well for evaluation sessions like yours:

- 15-minute micro-demo focused on the product surface and integration points (good for heads of product)
- 30-minute technical walkthrough with an engineer (recommended if you want to discuss quantization/throughput)

I can offer 15-minute slots tomorrow at 17:00Z (9am PT) or 18:00Z (10am PT). If neither works, drop a time that fits your team and I’ll coordinate.

I also attached a short 10-minute overview you can watch now — it'll give Maya and the team the highlights while we lock a live slot.

Attached: redwood-10min-overview.pdf (10MB, slide+recording stub)

Best,
Soojin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Cc: Oliver Grant <oliver@brightgrid.co>, Maya Lee <maya@brightgrid.co>
Date: 2029-11-08 19:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Apologies — missed our demo today

Looping in a couple quick micro-slot ideas — if BrightGrid wants a very short touch to get momentum, we can offer:

- 10 min "speed tour" focusing on latency/cost examples for recommenders
- 20 min "integration map" with the AE to sketch common ingestion patterns

If you pick the 10-minute speed tour, I can run it and then hand off to Tessa for deeper follow-up. Otherwise, Tessa, would you prefer to take a 30-min technical slot?

— Priyom (SDR)

Date: 2029-11-09 07:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Apologies — missed our demo today

Hi Oliver / Maya — I can cover a 20–30 minute slot if you'd like to dive a bit into integration and performance tradeoffs. My calendar has availability tomorrow 17:00Z (9am PT) and the day after at 17:30Z (9:30am PT).

If you prefer a quicker touch first, Priyom is happy to do the 10-minute speed tour — he can run through cost/latency examples and handoff to me.

Here are two links — pick whichever works:
- 15-min speed tour (Priyom): https://calendar.redwood.ai/s/priyom/15min
- 30-min technical walkthrough (Tessa): https://calendar.redwood.ai/s/tessa/30min

I attached a one-pager for BrightGrid's evaluation team (same file Soojin attached) so you have the main criteria up front.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Oliver Grant <oliver@brightgrid.co>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Lee <maya@brightgrid.co>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-11-09 08:47:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Apologies — missed our demo today

Thanks all — booking the 30-min walkthrough with Tessa at 17:00Z tomorrow (confirmed via your link). Maya and I will watch the 10-minute overview first. Looking forward to talking integration details — can you include a short agenda for the call?

Agenda request: 1) integration options (streams vs batch), 2) latency/cost examples for 99th percentile loads, 3) security controls for PII, 4) next steps & pilot scope.

See you then,
Oliver
